picks.headline: Self-driving lab speeds up materials development
picks.title: Self-driving lab speeds up materials development
picks.excerpt: The new Energy Materials Acceleration Platform (E-MAP) at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (KIT) enables a systematic examination, evaluation, and targeted refining of thousands of material variants. It links automated experiments with precise material characterization, thus creating the foundation for the accelerated development of energy materials.
picks.rationale: Concrete, operating AI-driven autonomous lab (KIT E-MAP) for energy materials; directly addresses the 'labs lag AI' bottleneck covered earlier without repeating it.

picks.headline: QC Design Reports 10x Logical Error Reduction With Meridian AI
picks.title: QC Design Reports 10x Logical Error Reduction With Meridian AI
picks.excerpt: QC Design reports that its Meridian AI system achieved over 10x lower logical error rates than published methods across 100+ quantum design tasks.
picks.rationale: Adds a quantum-computing axis absent from recent science cards; AI system claiming 10x lower logical error rates across 100+ design tasks (company-reported, to be attributed as such).

picks.headline: Shared blueprint in aphid proteins helps AI predict their structures
picks.title: Shared blueprint in aphid proteins helps AI predict their structures
picks.excerpt: Tiny insects called aphids inject hundreds of mysterious proteins into plants, hijacking the plants' own genomes to build galls: structures made of plant tissue but constructed to the insects' specifications to house and feed their offspring.
picks.rationale: Fresh life-science use of AI structure prediction (insect gall-inducing effector proteins, basic biology; no pathogen-enhancement angle) with a visual, story-driven hook.

picks.headline: Open-source benchmark tests whether AI agents can engineer working robots
picks.title: Open-source benchmark tests whether AI agents can engineer working robots
picks.excerpt: With the rapid rise of artificial intelligence in daily life, software coding has become increasingly automated, with powerful AI systems known as coding agents able to write and revise computer programs almost autonomously. But what happens when an AI agent must contend not just with digital command lines, but with the physical world of robotics?
picks.rationale: Open-source benchmark measuring coding agents on physical robot engineering; actionable for anyone evaluating agents beyond software tasks.

picks.headline: AI Use and Emotional Problems in Children and Teens
picks.title: AI Use and Emotional Problems in Children and Teens
picks.excerpt: Researchers discover an association between affective generative AI use and mental health problems in youth.
picks.rationale: Freshest item in pool; brings a psychology/youth-wellbeing axis and a new outlet, reporting research linking affective gen-AI use to emotional problems in minors.
